name: ZopDev MCP
description: Cloud cost and infrastructure governance across AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake: 263 tools (155 read, 108 write) spanning cost, resources, schedules, recommendations, budgets, and diagnostics. Read-only by default, with optional scoped writes. Install: `claude mcp add zopdev https://api.zop.dev/mcp-server -t http` (OAuth 2.1 signs you in; add `--header "Authorization: Bearer zn_pat_YOUR_TOKEN"` for CI) · [Repo](https://github.com/zopdev/mcp) · [Claude setup](https://zop.dev/learn/how-to/set-up-zopnight-mcp-for-claude)
